Theme

Household, washing & chores · Nature & food

nursery noun

where young plants are raised

also seed bed, seedbed, nursery garden, nursery bed, seedlings (the place for)

classical

Cato Agr. 46 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 18.295 (Lewis & Short)

sēminārium, sēmināriī n.

noun, second declension

a nursery garden, a seed bed

From sēmen, seed; in Cicero also figuratively, a breeding ground.

Other words

  • plantārium, plantāriī n. — a nursery bed for young plants

    noun, second declension · also used · post-classical · Plin. NH 13.37: plantāria īnstituunt anniculāsque trānsferunt (Lewis & Short); Plin. NH 17.149 (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • plantāria īnstituunt anniculāsque trānsferunt

    they lay out nursery beds and move the plants when a year oldPlin. NH 13.37 (Lewis & Short)

See also transplant, seed, sow, sprout, garden.
